units.source: Bookmarks
units.context: Bookmarks

units.source: Frequently used notes can be bookmarked, which will make them appear in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for easy access.
units.context: Bookmarks

units.source: Configuring the launch bar__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Bookmarks > Configuring the launch bar

units.source: If bookmarks don't appear in the launch bar, then most likely the bookmark section has been hidden. Go to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ configuration from the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and ensure __TRILIUM_PH_4__Bookmarks__TRILIUM_PH_5__ is in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Visible Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_7__ section.
units.context: Bookmarks > Configuring the launch bar

units.source: Bookmark folder__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Bookmarks > Bookmark folder

units.source: Space in the left panel is limited, and you might want to bookmark many items. One possible solution is to bookmark a folder, so it shows its children:
units.context: Bookmarks > Bookmark folder

units.source: To do this, bookmark a folder, then right click its button in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and check __TRILIUM_PH_2__Show as a folder__TRILIUM_PH_3__. The button then opens a menu instead of the note itself: the note is at the top, followed by its children. Uncheck __TRILIUM_PH_4__Show as a folder__TRILIUM_PH_5__ to turn it back into a regular bookmark.
units.context: Bookmarks > Bookmark folder

units.source: A child that has children of its own shows an arrow at the end of its row. Click the arrow to list its children in a submenu, or click the rest of the row to open the note. Submenus nest up to four levels deep. A menu that lists more than 15 children shows a filter field above them: type part of a title to list only the notes that match. A note whose subtree is hidden (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Hiding the subtree__TRILIUM_PH_1__) doesn't list its children here either.
units.context: Bookmarks > Bookmark folder

units.source: The notes in the menu open the way links do: a middle click or __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+click opens a note in a new tab, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__+click opens it in a new window, and a right click lists the other places it can be opened in.
units.context: Bookmarks > Bookmark folder

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Show as a folder__TRILIUM_PH_1__ assigns the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ label to the note, so adding the label by hand works as well. Because the label belongs to the note, a note that is both bookmarked and dropped onto the launch bar shows its children in both places.
units.context: Bookmarks > Bookmark folder

units.source: Choosing where a bookmark opens__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Bookmarks > Choosing where a bookmark opens

units.source: A bookmark opens its note in the current tab. To open it somewhere else, right click its button in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and pick a place under __TRILIUM_PH_2__Open mode__TRILIUM_PH_3__. The place in effect is checked.
units.context: Bookmarks > Choosing where a bookmark opens

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open mode__TRILIUM_PH_1__ sets the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ label on the note, so adding the label by hand works as well. The label works the same way for a note dropped onto the launch bar and for the notes in a bookmark folder's menu. On a folder, __TRILIUM_PH_3__Open mode__TRILIUM_PH_4__ makes the label inheritable, so every note in the folder's menu and its submenus follows it, the folder's own note included (see __TRILIUM_PH_5__Attribute Inheritance__TRILIUM_PH_6__). A note in the folder can still have a value of its own, such as __TRILIUM_PH_7__, added by hand.
units.context: Bookmarks > Choosing where a bookmark opens

units.source: The open mode applies to a plain click only. A middle click or __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+click still opens the note in a new tab, and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__+click on a note in a folder's menu still opens it in a new window.
units.context: Bookmarks > Choosing where a bookmark opens

units.source: Mobile__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Bookmarks > Mobile

units.source: On mobile, bookmarks are only displayed starting with v0.102.0. Because of the more constrained screen size, the bookmarks are grouped under a single icon instead of displaying them as separate icons.
units.context: Bookmarks > Mobile

units.source: When pressed, a menu will appear listing all the bookmarks. Bookmark folders are also supported and will appear as submenus. Each submenu starts with its own note, so a note with children can be opened as well as browsed.
units.context: Bookmarks > Mobile

units.source: On a phone, the bookmarks are also listed at the top of the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ while it shows the root of a tab that is not hoisted, below the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Workspaces__TRILIUM_PH_3__. Tap a bookmark to open it, or, for one with children, to list them, as with the other notes of the tree.
units.context: Bookmarks > Mobile
